unmatchedPoints.text: Product and Compliance gave different definitions of "customer data" and no agreement is recorded, which leaves the export scope open.

unsourcedClaims.text: Eng can ship a profile-data-only export this sprint.
unsourcedClaims.reason: Only Product's own Slack note supports this. The transcript only mentions keeping the export small, and no Eng attendee confirmed the timeline.

docContradictions.claimText: The export only needs to cover profile data, so Eng can ship it this sprint.
docContradictions.explanation: Privacy Policy v3 says "Customer data" covers all data held about a customer, including derived analytics, so a profile-only export conflicts with it.
